title: Tracker binding
description: The shape of ak.tracker.yaml, the file at a project folder's root that says how this checkout reaches its ticket backend: which binding, where the project-local secret is, and the backend defaults ticket operations use. It is not the system-of-record decision, which is the project record's `tracker_policy.system_of_record` (schemas/project.schema.json); a binding that reaches a different system refuses every operation (adapters/tracker/CONTRACT.md §5; ruling `tracker-of-record-falls-back-to-kb`). The file holds no secret and is committed, so every checkout binds the same backend, team and statuses; the secret lives in the gitignored file `token_file` names. The root object and `statuses` refuse unknown keys, so a token pasted under a new top-level or status key is a schema error. `defaults` is open here, any key with a nonempty string value; only a backend schema restricts its keys. No schema inspects values, so a token pasted as a value under `defaults` or `statuses` is not detected.

backend.description: The binding's id, as adapters/tracker/backends/<id>.md names it. Free-form in this schema, which keeps no list of vendors; `ak tracker check` refuses an id with no such document (tracker.backend-unknown).

token_file.description: The project-local secret, as a path relative to the project folder that stays inside it. It must be gitignored, untracked and absent from history; `ak tracker check` verifies all three and never prints the file's contents. With the file absent or empty every operation refuses before the backend is invoked, so an operator-global credential is never reached.

defaults.description: Where ticket operations write and read in the backend, so they use the project's scope rather than whatever the credential's account can reach. Which keys a backend requires is its binding's to state, in schemas/tracker-backends/<backend>.schema.json beside adapters/tracker/backends/<backend>.md; `ak tracker check` applies it after this schema. This schema names no vendor.

statuses.description: The backend's own name for each `ticket` status (schemas/ticket.schema.json) this project uses. A status with no entry is one updateStatus refuses to write on this backend, rather than guessing a name the backend's workflow may not have.
